key_conclusions.summary: The online strategy hot path is dominated by per-bar DataFrame rebuild and full-window indicator recomputation.
evidence: runtime benchmark: empty strategy 228890.6 bars/s, trend_following 350.2 bars/s, three real strategies 125.7 bars/s

key_conclusions.summary: The validation gate multiplies optimization, signal generation, and backtest cost across CPCV and two WFO modes.

key_conclusions.summary: DataStore and FeatureStore append paths rewrite whole monthly partitions.
CLI research workflows do not push date/timeframe filters into DuckDB queries.

acceptance_criteria: python scripts/check_env.py reports READY or accurately classifies optional dependencies
incremental and vectorized signal parity is covered by deterministic tests
three real strategies reach at least 2000 bars/s on the 2000-bar synthetic benchmark
identical train slice and params evaluations are cached within a run

acceptance_criteria: research, optimize, and validate push date/timeframe filters into DataStore.query

residual_risks: Incremental strategy logic can drift from vectorized research logic without parity tests.
